body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_n\), first express all perturbation bounds through \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}=\inf_{(i,t)\in G\times W}\sigma_r(M^{it})\). The native and neighborhood-replaced fits satisfy \(|(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\Delta^{\mathrm{aux}}_{it}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), and the native estimator obeys \((gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})=L+Q+R_{\mathrm{agg}}\), where \(|Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4/(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\sqrt n))\), \(|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n)\), \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{\log n/m}+\log n/m+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}^2)\), \(|\widehat B_2-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+\Delta_\gamma/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}})\), and \(\sum_i\|\widehat w_{i\cdot}-w_{i\cdot}\|_2^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2)\). The term \(R_{\mathrm{agg}}\) contains the cubic, penalty, and native-transfer components fixed by its definition. Since \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\le\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\le\psi\), substitution changes only constants. Under \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), the corresponding remainder-to-standard-error ratios are bounded by terms of orders \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), \(\ell_n^4n\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2\), \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/n\), and \(\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), all \(o_{\mathbb P}(1)\).
body.justification: This is the unresolved bridge from a target-specific, conditionally independent neighborhood-replaced proof device to second-order inference for the native masked optimizer.
body.gap: Choi, Kwon, and Liao prove first-order auxiliary equivalence under independent noise, while Choi and Yuan prove neighborhood deletion for fully observed PCA; neither controls this centered aggregate through a masked proximal map.
body.consumer: The theorem certifies that feasible correction and studentization can be applied to the estimator already used for the SEC Tick Size Pilot panel.

obligation.what_is_open: A uniform second-order expansion of the implemented masked nuclear-norm fixed point, including simultaneous active-rank stability, centered aggregation across overlapping local fits, regularization and cubic errors, pretreatment reconstruction, curvature plug-in stability, and relative fitted-weight consistency.
obligation.obstruction: The exact proximal identity is a nonsmooth self-consistency equation. The frozen assumptions and established lemmas do not provide a uniform contraction or active-rank neighborhood for every native fit, nor a concentration theorem for the aggregate of their shared-data quadratic and higher-order terms. Pointwise projector Taylor formulas and nonexpansiveness do not imply the asserted signed aggregate rates.
obligation.attempted: The optimizer was reduced to its exact singular-value-thresholding fixed point, the complete differential and target-coordinate auxiliary separation were retained, and every asserted raw error was converted to the oracle standard-error scale. The prescribed interior exponent check closes conditionally on those raw rates, but deriving the rates from the native optimizer remains the missing new argument.
obligation.partial_result:
The established proximal identity, complete tangent formula, and auxiliary measurability result reduce the unresolved part to one precise native-map estimate.  The actual optimizer satisfies
\[
 \widetilde M^{it}=\operatorname{SVT}_{\lambda}\!\left(
 P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}Y^{\mathrm{obs}}
 +P_{(\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it})^c}\widetilde M^{it}
 \right),
\]
and the first differential of the associated completion branch is the declared donor-window plus treated-pre minus donor-pre score.  The neighborhood-replaced fit is conditionally separated from the target coordinate.  These facts do not supply a uniform differentiable branch for the nonsmooth self-consistent map.

If the raw bounds in the target theorem are established, their standard-error consequences are deterministic.  From \(s\ge c(nH)^{-1/2}\) and \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\ge c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\),
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{|Q-B_2|}{s}
 &=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}}\right),\\
 \frac{|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|}{s}
 &=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
   \frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2}
   +\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{n}
 \right),\\
 \frac{|\widehat B_2-B_2|}{s}
 &=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
   \frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2}
   +\frac{\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}}{\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}}
 \right).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Under the stated signal envelope, the first three deterministic factors are bounded by constant multiples of
\[
 n^{-1/2-\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^{-4},
 \qquad n^{-2\eta}\ell_n^{-12},
 \qquad \ell_n^4\sqrt H/n,
\]
which vanish because \(H\le Cn\).  The asserted pretreatment rate and \(m\asymp n\) would also give \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2n^{-1/2})\), making the covariance plug-in ratio vanish.

For the prescribed interior calibration \(H\asymp n\) and \(\psi=n^{4/5}\), the asserted raw rates would imply
\[
 n|Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4n^{-3/10}),
 \qquad
 n|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4n^{-1/10}+\ell_n^4n^{-1/2}),
\]
and
\[
 n|\widehat B_2-B_2|
 =O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4n^{-1/10}+\ell_n^2n^{-3/10}),
\]
so all three would vanish.  This verifies the exponent arithmetic but does not certify the implemented optimizer: the missing statement remains the uniform native fixed-point expansion and its centered aggregate concentration.
